verdicts.reason: A is mostly the original layout centred on the wider canvas. It reads cleanly with a clear hierarchy, but there are wide empty side margins, the legal line runs into the missing-asset badge box at bottom right, and bokeh dots sit on the body copy (over 'bottled'). B does rearrange into two columns, but the badges are stacked in pills of mismatched widths that don't share an edge (the dark AWARD pill hangs out to the left), the left text column is cramped, the product floats low on the right in dead space, and the SUNSET SALE ribbon is isolated, so the layout looks lopsided and arbitrary.
